alfred_messages: Batman is currently brooding on a gargoyle. I took the liberty of packing him an umbrella.
Sir, Gotham appears suspiciously peaceful. Might I suggest a warm cup of Earl Grey instead of nocturnal surveillance?
Threat level is 97%. Crime level is 0%. I recommend ignoring both with haste.
Emergency protocol activated. Absolutely nothing happened, as per protocol.
Looking for something useful, sir? I recommend drinking water and getting eight hours of sleep.
Sir, after reviewing the schematics, I have also been unable to determine why this $4 billion computer exists.
Batman is staring dramatically at nothing again. The gargoyle is beginning to look fatigued.
The Batmobile is polished and parked. Batman refuses to come inside.
Sir, perhaps you should consider going outside during daylight hours. Vitamin D is essential for vigilance.
Batman has been brooding for 6 hours straight. I have logged this as a moderate improvement over yesterday.
The coffee is freshly brewed, sir. However, your cowl remains stubbornly fastened.
Justice is being served. At approximately the speed of an elderly snail in a heavy drizzle.
Sir, the Bat-Signal is on. Gordon appears to have sat on the switch again.
Gotham is safe. Batman is deeply suspicious that the peace is an elaborate conspiracy.
I have prepared the evening pot roast. Batman is currently crouching on the refrigerator.
Sir, you have been staring intently at the crime telemetry screen for 4 hours. It is currently displaying a screensaver.
The system is functioning with 100% operational precision. This is thoroughly disappointing.
Batman is doing important detective work. Or he is contemplating his cape physics.
Sir, the threat level has remained at 97% since Tuesday. I suggest adjusting the calibration or taking a nap.
I have detected absolutely no criminal activity. Batman remains unconvinced and is glaring at a pigeon.
Master Bruce, the laundry service has once again inquired why all your suits are matte carbon-black.
Sir, Robin attempted to operate the Batcomputer and accidentally ordered 400 pepperoni pizzas.
I must inform you that standing on gargoyles during a lightning storm is statistically unsound, sir.
Master Bruce, Lucius Fox called to ask why Wayne Enterprises purchased eighteen tons of black graphite.
The Batcave moisture level is at 94%. We are legally categorized as a temperate rainforest.
Sir, I took the liberty of setting your alarm for 3:00 AM so you would not miss optimal brooding hours.
Gotham Central reports that the Joker is currently stuck in traffic on the West Gotham Expressway.
Master Bruce, brooding does not burn sufficient calories to replace a proper dinner.
I have synchronized your utility belt with the manor thermostat. You are welcome, sir.
Sir, Commissioner Gordon left a voicemail asking if we have seen his favorite reading glasses.
The Batmobile GPS has recalculated your route 47 times because you insist on taking only dark alleyways.
Master Bruce, even the Dark Knight requires adequate calcium intake.
Sir, the gargoyle on the north wing has filed a structural complaint regarding your posture.
I took the liberty of adding chamomile to your tactical hydration pouch. You seemed tense.
Master Bruce, staring at surveillance footage of empty rooftops does not constitute a social life.
